decisions.rule: Treat the XRP Insights Oct29 08:00–Oct30 08:00 UTC same-wallet change (-207.3M XRP) as an event-window observation that contains the Binance incident, not as a Binance-specific theft amount.
decisions.rationale: The five-wallet 233.46M XRP incident occurred Oct29 20:05–20:09 UTC, between the two daily snapshots. The -207.3M is across the tracked exchange universe and is 88.8% of the incident amount, but no per-exchange daily breakdown or source-wallet crosswalk is available.

decisions.rule: Keep all-exchange daily change, all-exchange 7d/30d change, Binance-specific 7d/30d change and CryptoQuant reserve series separate. Do not merge them into one reserve-flow feature.
decisions.rationale: The all-exchange 7d change (-234.9M) is numerically close to the incident amount but not Binance-only; Binance-specific 7d change is -173.2M; CryptoQuant's approximately -220M series uses a different wallet universe.

decisions.rule: Retain SBI VC Trade's 59.5M XRP across two public-labeled wallets as exchange/custody infrastructure evidence; do not classify as SBI Group proprietary holdings.
decisions.rationale: Public XRPSCAN labels and balances are not official PoR, customer liabilities or beneficial-owner records.

decisions.rule: Do not assign the 26.16M XRP arithmetic difference between the -207.3M daily aggregate and 233.46M incident transfer to deposits, withdrawals or any specific actor.
decisions.rationale: All-exchange aggregate includes multiple venues; no per-exchange daily breakdown or per-wallet history.

next_actions: Map the five incident source wallets into the 153-wallet Binance set used by XRP Insights.
Obtain raw XRPL account_info and transaction history for each source wallet and the attacker receiver.
Obtain per-exchange daily balance changes or independently calculate them from the same wallet set.
Compare Binance PoR reserve addresses and customer liabilities at identical timestamps.
Use event-study controls (BTC/ETH, unaffected exchanges, non-incident days) before estimating any causal effect.
Keep the event-window observation out of predictive features until leakage-safe walk-forward validation.
